title: Missing disable check in stop function
detail: The stop function was previously calling self.live.stop() and printing a blank line regardless of the disable flag. This caused disabled progress displays to still output blank lines on non-interactive consoles when they should not. The fix adds an if not self.disable check to prevent these actions when the progress is disabled.

title: Breaking change to accept_html behavior
detail: The change removes the XHTML/XML matching from accept_html, which is a breaking change. Existing code that relies on accept_html to match XHTML content will now fail, causing unexpected behavior in applications that depend on this functionality.
